params.name: api_key
params.description: Calendarific API key issued via the developer console.

params.name: country
params.description: ISO-3166 country code (e.g., US, GB, IN).

params.name: year
params.description: Year to retrieve holidays for. Historical data available through 2049.

params.name: day
params.description: Filter to a specific day of the month (1-31).

params.name: location
params.description: ISO-3166 state or region code (e.g., us-ca for California).

params.name: type
params.description: Filter by holiday type (national, local, religious, observance).

params.name: language
params.description: Premium parameter. Two-letter ISO639 language code.

params.name: uuid
params.description: Premium parameter. Include UUID values for each holiday.

items.docs:
Returns holidays for a given country and year. Supports filtering
by month, day, location (sub-region), holiday type, and language.
